title: A code generator joins the project showcase
summary:
A community code generator joined the showcase, while text error handling and ad routing got tidier.

The project list and LLM Integrations page now include a community-built Websim app that generates code from a description and programming language, with explainer and reviewer modes.

Error logging now tolerates null entries in message arrays instead of throwing a second error while handling the first one. Software has enough layers of errors already.

A broad referrer exclusion was narrowed, Windsurf and Claude AI were added to affiliate options, and Character.AI’s selection weight was reduced.
